abstract: Prior approaches to Long-Horizon Forecasting, such as N-BEATS, struggle with high computational latency and achieve only 0.272 Normalized Deviation on Weather-Bench. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HyperTrans-Pro. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that HyperTrans-Pro establishes a new state of the art, attaining 0.349 Normalized Deviation on Weather-Bench while reducing parameter overhead by 30%.

We present an empirical study on Table Structure Recognition using GraphPrior-Plus (13B parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including DocFormer, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging PubTables-1M dataset, reaching an unprecedented Tree-Edit Distance of 88.8% (surpassing DocFormer's score of 84.8%). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.

We present an empirical study on Phoneme Recognition using FlashArch-Plus (350M parameters). When benchmarked against competitive baselines including Wav2Vec-2.0, our method demonstrates superior representational capacity on the challenging CommonVoice-EN dataset, reaching an unprecedented Word Error Rate of 2.9% (surpassing Wav2Vec-2.0's score of 0.5%). Qualitative analysis confirms the stability of our optimization objective.
